Export mergeRanges(ranges) from src/ranges.mjs. Input is an array of [start,end] finite number pairs with start <= end. Return sorted merged ranges: overlapping or touching ranges merge. Preserve existing exports and tests. Add at least one executable test in test/. Only src/ and test/ are writable; existing tests are protected.

result.finalText:
All checks pass (build, test, public-examples).

Implemented in `src/ranges.mjs`:
- Added `mergeRanges(ranges)` export, preserving `protocolVersion = 1`.
- Validates input: must be an array of exactly-2-element `[start, end]` pairs with finite numbers and `start <= end`; violations throw `TypeError` with an index in the message.
- Copies pairs before sorting, so it never mutates the input and output pairs are fresh arrays (no shared references).
- Merges overlapping or touching ranges (e.g. `[1,3]` + `[5,8]` stays separate; `[2,5]` + `[5,8]` merges into `[2,8]`), returns sorted result; empty input returns `[]`.

Added `test/merge-ranges.test.mjs` covering merging, empty input, unsorted input, no-mutation / no-shared-array invariants, and all TypeError cases (non-array, wrong arity, reversed, Infinity, NaN, non-numbers).

Verified via `mcp__task__check`: build PASS, all 5 tests pass (including the protected existing test), public-examples PASS.
